title: Shared wire vocabulary
description: Types more than one route speaks. A word that means the same thing in two places is defined once, so the two cannot drift apart.

Evidence.description: HOW a reading was obtained. Every observed field travels with one of these, because a structured event and a screen guess are different kinds of fact and a reader must be able to tell them apart.

SessionState.description: What the session appears to be doing. `unknown` is a real answer and is never flattened into `idle`.

MoverKind.description: Who can clear an obligation. Naming the mover is what turns a stuck list into an actionable one.

Icon.description: A project mark with an RGB accent and either bounded colour cells (null is transparent) or a self-contained static SVG with empty cells. Both render proportionally inside the existing icon slot.

svg.description: Optional self-contained SVG; cells is empty when present.

Refusal.description: Every refusal on this daemon has this shape. A caller reads `error` as the code and never parses `detail`.

detail_key.description: Optional stable catalog key for this exact fixed English detail. Dynamic details have no key.
